initial_prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE English Patterns learning atlas.
Pattern context: I brush my teeth + optional time / duration / method. Style: Photorealistic everyday editorial photography, warm natural light, coherent with the existing learning atlases.
Canvas width:height MUST be THREE:FOUR (0.75), not 1:2. Exactly 3 columns by 4 rows of SQUARE photographic cells, with narrow continuous pure white divider gutters. All twelve cells visible. Final display contract 1536x2048.
Conservative Arab Muslim family learning contexts. Men wear loose opaque long-sleeved high-neck shirts and full-length trousers or thobes. Women wear loose opaque full-coverage clothing and hijab. Apply modest clothing to background people too.
No bare torso, shoulders, midriff or thighs, tight or transparent clothes, revealing nightwear, swimwear, underwear, changing, bathing, showering, intimate or romantic poses, kissing or inappropriate physical contact.
Water and beach contexts use fully clothed people on a dry shore, promenade or empty poolside. Never show swimmers, sunbathers, mixed bathing or distant revealing figures. Depict swimming discussions before the activity, with equipment where useful.
No alcohol, gambling, nightclub setting, graphic injury, active weapon violence, or religious caricatures. Use ordinary respectful Arab settings without adding religious rituals unrelated to the sentence.
Preserve the exact English sentence and Arabic meaning. Adapt only the visual staging. If a compliant scene cannot convey the meaning honestly, hold the cell for review instead of substituting an unrelated picture.
No captions, words, numbers, logos, speech/thought bubbles, graphic overlays or floating inset pictures. Physical analog clocks can use hands and tick marks for time examples.
Exactly three columns and four rows in row-major order, twelve square cells, portrait 3:4, final atlas 1536x2048, 512x512 per cell with 40px safe inset and continuous straight white dividers. Measure actual source gutters before preparing the display atlas.
The following English sentences are context only: do not render their text. Exact panel order, left to right then top to bottom:
1. Meaning: I brush my teeth every morning. Visual staging: An adult brushing teeth at a bathroom sink in morning light. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
2. Meaning: I brush my teeth after breakfast. Visual staging: An adult brushing teeth after breakfast.
3. Meaning: I brush my teeth before bed. Visual staging: An adult in pajamas brushing teeth before bed. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
4. Meaning: I brush my teeth for two minutes. Visual staging: An adult brushing teeth beside a small timer.
5. Meaning: I brush my teeth before I leave for work. Visual staging: An adult brushing teeth with work clothes ready nearby.
6. Meaning: I brush my teeth with a soft toothbrush. Visual staging: An adult holding a soft toothbrush beside a bathroom sink. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
7. Meaning: I brush my teeth after eating breakfast. Visual staging: An adult brushing teeth after setting aside breakfast dishes.
8. Meaning: I brush my teeth even when I feel tired. Visual staging: A tired adult brushing teeth in a softly lit bathroom. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
9. Meaning: I brush my teeth and then rinse my mouth. Visual staging: An adult rinsing their mouth beside a toothbrush and sink.
10. Meaning: I brush my teeth before going to bed. Visual staging: An adult in pajamas brushing teeth at night. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
11. Meaning: I brush my teeth while my brother washes his face. Visual staging: Two brothers using separate sides of a bathroom sink. Fully clothed in loose opaque long sleeves and full-length garments; blankets cover lower bodies in bed; never depict changing or bathing.
12. Meaning: I brush my teeth carefully, not in a hurry. Visual staging: An adult calmly and carefully brushing teeth at a mirror.


Composition priority: exact 3:4 portrait canvas, twelve equal SQUARE photographs, 3 columns by 4 rows, white continuous gutters. Photograph only fully clothed adults in loose opaque high-neck LONG sleeves. No bath, shower stall, toilet, undressing, bare chest, bare shoulders, or revealing clothes anywhere. Women wear opaque hijab and loose full coverage garments; men wear long-sleeved thobes or loose shirts, full trousers. Frame faces, hands, toothbrush and sink safely inside each cell. Each panel shows actual brushing with toothbrush touching teeth or the specifically requested rinsing action, not merely holding an unrelated prop. Panel 2 has a breakfast tray visible through an open doorway behind a man brushing at a sink. Panel 4 includes a small analog kitchen timer without digits or text. Panel 5 fully dressed man in work clothes with closed work bag by door brushing before leaving. Panel 6 close view soft-bristle toothbrush beside a modestly dressed adult brushing gently, no exaggerated giant brush. Panel 7 breakfast dishes set aside safely on a dry separate counter while adult brushes. Panel 8 tired adult with slight sleepy expression brushing. Panel 9 adult rinses mouth with clean water cup; toothbrush rests beside sink. Panel 11 two adult brothers in long sleeves at separate sinks, one brushing teeth and one washing face. No readable words, labels, symbols or digits.
edit_prompt: Recompose this educational tooth-brushing atlas onto a NEW wider canvas with EXACT THREE TO FOUR aspect ratio (width divided by height 0.75), e.g. 1536 pixels wide x 2048 pixels tall. The input is too narrow: do NOT copy its 1:2 aspect ratio or tall rectangular panel shape. EXACTLY THREE columns and FOUR rows, TWELVE SQUARE photographic panels, all same size, thin straight continuous white gutters. Zoom out/recompose each photo into its square without losing the toothbrush, hands, sink or important context. Keep the same twelve scenes and their exact row-major order: morning brushing; brushing after breakfast with breakfast visible through doorway; brushing before bed in fully opaque loose long-sleeved high-neck sleepwear; brushing with small analog timer; brushing before work with work bag and clothes nearby; inspecting soft toothbrush beside sink; brushing after breakfast dishes set aside on separate dry counter; sleepy adult brushing; rinsing mouth with cup at sink and toothbrush on counter; brushing before bed; two brothers at separate sinks one brushing one washing face; careful calm brushing. Men must have loose opaque long sleeves and high-neck shirts or thobes with full coverage, no bare chest, shoulders or underwear, no bath or shower activity. No readable words, digits, letters, labels, logos or overlays. Preserve warm realistic photographic style. Output MUST be a 3:4 rectangle built from twelve SQUARE cells, NOT a 1:2 rectangle.
